name: @apier-no/mcp
description: Apier MCP Server — Norwegian company data and compliance for AI agents. Hardened thin proxy connecting local MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Zed) to Apier's hosted MCP server at https://www.apier.no/api/mcp: Brønnøysund company data, Altinn 3 compliance, signing authority, filing deadlines and fullmakt. Try the API without a key via the keyless sandbox mirror under /api/v1/sandbox/ on apier.no (direct HTTP calls; the proxy itself requires APIER_API_KEY).
author: Grov Digital (org.nr. 833 397 982)
